The vertical axis does not have any tick labels, so the claim that it has intervals of 0.1 is hallucinated.
The category is incorrectly named 'SUMS54' instead of the correct 'SUMSS4'.

The description fails to mention the main trend visible in the chart: that for all categories, the values for the 'Бизнес' group (orange bars) are higher than or equal to the values for the 'Студенти' group (blue bars).
